status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Blueprint
summary: Make the structure visible. Precise lines, measured spacing, technical clarity.
use_when: Use for process maps, technical training, implementation plans, and structured dashboards.
avoid_when: Avoid for long narrative reading without a quieter reading surface.
typography: System monospace for headings and labels; system sans-serif for body text.
layout: Consistent grid, aligned edges, numbered sections, explicit relationships.
surfaces: Dark navy surfaces, thin cyan rules, 3px corners, subtle grid outside text blocks.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Blueprint to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace for headings and labels; system sans-serif for body text. Consistent grid, aligned edges, numbered sections, explicit relationships. Dark navy surfaces, thin cyan rules, 3px corners, subtle grid outside text blocks. Palette: background #081e42, surface #102c50, text #eff8ff, muted #b0cce4, accent #8fe1ff, border #426c93. Essential traits: Schematic labels and structure; Thin high-contrast lines; Numbered modules. Avoid: Dense grids behind body text; All-caps body paragraphs; Decoration that resembles real measurements. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
